args.body:
Summary of websites posted in #general:

1. www.informations.com (posted by Bob): An article covering the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (posted by Eve): Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. With warm wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire, it offers a delightful journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site is clean and simple, which is a good start, but it's currently quite minimal — it only mentions that it's your personal website and lists your email. I'd suggest adding more content about yourself, such as your background, interests, projects, or work experience. Including a short bio, some photos, and maybe links to your social profiles or portfolio would make it much more engaging and give visitors a better sense of who you are. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog highlights your favorite hobby, hiking — that's a great personal touch! To make it even better, I'd suggest adding more content, such as blog posts about your favorite hiking trails, tips for beginners, photos from your adventures, or gear recommendations. Sharing your hiking experiences would make the blog more engaging and give readers a reason to come back. Overall, a nice start — keep it up!
